{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Cache.Client where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as B
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Crypto.Random (getSystemDRG, randomBytesGenerate)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.Word (Word8)

type SessionId = ByteString
type NodeId = ByteString

data RateLimitState = RateLimitState
  { rlTokens :: !Int
  , rlLastRefill :: !POSIXTime
  , rlMaxTokens :: !Int
  , rlRefillRate :: !Int
  } deriving (Show)

data CacheSession = CacheSession
  { csSessionId :: !SessionId
  , csNodeId :: !NodeId
  , csCreatedAt :: !POSIXTime
  , csLastAccess :: !POSIXTime
  , csRetryCount :: !Int
  , csAuthenticated :: !Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data CacheClient = CacheClient
  { ccSessions :: MVar (Map.Map SessionId CacheSession)
  , ccRateLimit :: IORef RateLimitState
  , ccMaxRetries :: !Int
  , ccSessionTimeout :: !NominalDiffTime
  }

newCacheClient :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO CacheClient
newCacheClient maxRetries timeout = do
  sessions <- newMVar Map.empty
  now <- getPOSIXTime
  rl <- newIORef $ RateLimitState 100 now 100 10
  return $ CacheClient sessions rl maxRetries timeout

-- Generate a session ID using a cryptographically secure random source.
-- We map each secure random byte into the printable ASCII range [0x21, 0x7e]
-- to preserve the original ID format while ensuring unpredictability.
generateSessionId :: IO SessionId
generateSessionId = do
  drg <- getSystemDRG
  let (raw, _) = randomBytesGenerate 32 drg :: (ByteString, _)
      lo = 0x21 :: Int
      hi = 0x7e :: Int
      range = hi - lo + 1
      toPrintable b = toEnum (lo + (fromIntegral b `mod` range))
  return $ BS.pack $ map toPrintable (B.unpack raw)

checkRateLimit :: CacheClient -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit client = do
  now <- getPOSIXTime
  atomicModifyIORef' (ccRateLimit client) $ \st ->
    let elapsed = now - rlLastRefill st
        refilled = min (rlMaxTokens st) $
          rlTokens st + floor (elapsed * fromIntegral (rlRefillRate st))
        newSt = st { rlTokens = refilled, rlLastRefill = now }
    in if refilled > 0
       then (newSt { rlTokens = refilled - 1 }, True)
       else (newSt, False)

authenticateSession :: CacheClient -> SessionId -> ByteString -> IO (Either String CacheSession)
authenticateSession client sid credentials = do
  allowed <- checkRateLimit client
  unless allowed $ error "Rate limit exceeded"
  sessions <- readMVar (ccSessions client)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Session not found"
    Just session -> do
      if validateCredentials credentials
        then do
          now <- getPOSIXTime
          newSid <- generateSessionId
          let authedSession = session { csSessionId = newSid, csAuthenticated = True, csLastAccess = now }
          modifyMVar_ (ccSessions client) $ \m ->
            return $ Map.insert newSid authedSession $ Map.delete sid m
          return $ Right authedSession
        else return $ Left "Invalid credentials"

validateCredentials :: ByteString -> Bool
validateCredentials cred = BS.length cred >= 8

connectToNode :: CacheClient -> NodeId -> Maybe SessionId -> IO (Either String CacheSession)
connectToNode client nodeId _requestedSid = do
  allowed <- checkRateLimit client
  unless allowed $ error "Rate limit exceeded"
  now <- getPOSIXTime
  sid <- generateSessionId
  let session = CacheSession
        { csSessionId = sid
        , csNodeId = nodeId
        , csCreatedAt = now
        , csLastAccess = now
        , csRetryCount = 0
        , csAuthenticated = False
        }
  modifyMVar_ (ccSessions client) $ \m ->
    return $ Map.insert sid session m
  return $ Right session

retryWithBackoff :: CacheClient -> CacheSession -> IO a -> IO (Either String a)
retryWithBackoff client session action = go 0
  where
    go attempt
      | attempt >= ccMaxRetries client = return $ Left "Max retries exceeded"
      | otherwise = do
          allowed <- checkRateLimit client
          if not allowed
            then return $ Left "Rate limited during retry"
            else do
              result <- (Right <$> action) `catch` (\e -> return $ Left (show (e :: IOError)))
              case result of
                Right val -> do
                  modifyMVar_ (ccSessions client) $ \m ->
                    return $ Map.adjust (\s -> s { csRetryCount = attempt }) (csSessionId session) m
                  return $ Right val
                Left _ -> go (attempt + 1)

cacheGet :: CacheClient -> CacheSession -> ByteString -> IO (Either String ByteString)
cacheGet client session key = do
  sessions <- readMVar (ccSessions client)
  case Map.lookup (csSessionId session) sessions of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Session expired"
    Just s -> do
      unless (csAuthenticated s) $ error "Not authenticated"
      now <- getPOSIXTime
      when (now - csLastAccess s > ccSessionTimeout client) $
        error "Session timed out"
      modifyMVar_ (ccSessions client) $ \m ->
        return $ Map.adjust (\sess -> sess { csLastAccess = now }) (csSessionId session) m
      return $ Right $ "value_for_" <> key

catch :: IO a -> (IOError -> IO a) -> IO a
catch = flip const `seq` ioErrorCatch
  where ioErrorCatch = undefined -- placeholder for Control.Exception.catch
